raw_block.rationale: Create a route- and cabin-sensitive airline calculator that fixes the observed process error: one qualifying carry-on is free, every other item is numbered as a checked bag, and each checked bag adds its positional fee plus the higher of its overweight and oversize fees. This reproduces both TRAIN answers while reading the current itinerary-specific tables rather than memorizing either answer.

skill.intent: Calculate the exact integer ticket price plus fees for all current bags when the applicable tables assign numeric fees and every checked bag is accepted.

outputs.description: Exact current ticket price plus all carry-on, checked-bag, overweight, and oversize fees.
outputs.name: answer

skill.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    total = int(inputs["ticket_price"])
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carry_limits = sorted(inputs["carry_on_dimension_limits"])
    base_fees = inputs["checked_base_fees"]
    standard_size = inputs["standard_checked_linear_size"]
    standard_weight = inputs["standard_checked_weight"]
    weight_uppers = inputs["overweight_upper_bounds"]
    weight_fees = inputs["overweight_fees"]
    size_uppers = inputs["oversize_upper_bounds"]
    size_fees = inputs["oversize_fees"]
    carry_used = False
    checked_index = 0
    for i in range(len(weights)):
        dims = sorted([lengths[i], widths[i], heights[i]])
        fits_carry = dims[0] <= carry_limits[0] and dims[1] <= carry_limits[1] and dims[2] <= carry_limits[2]
        if fits_carry and not carry_used:
            carry_used = True
        else:
            base_index = min(checked_index, len(base_fees) - 1)
            base_fee = base_fees[base_index]
            weight_fee = 0
            if weights[i] > standard_weight:
                for j in range(len(weight_uppers)):
                    if weights[i] <= weight_uppers[j] and weight_fee == 0:
                        weight_fee = weight_fees[j]
            linear_size = lengths[i] + widths[i] + heights[i]
            size_fee = 0
            if linear_size > standard_size:
                for j in range(len(size_uppers)):
                    if linear_size <= size_uppers[j] and size_fee == 0:
                        size_fee = size_fees[j]
            total = total + base_fee + max(weight_fee, size_fee)
            checked_index = checked_index + 1
    return {"answer": int(total)}
